hints.title: Catalan Balance Obstacle
hints.text: Generating all 2^(2N) binary sequences and filtering valid ones wastes computation on invalid prefixes. How can counting remaining parentheses prune illegal configurations instantly?

hints.title: Prefix Balance Invariant
hints.text: A closing parenthesis can only be placed if the number of open parentheses placed so far strictly exceeds the number of closed parentheses placed so far.

hints.title: Guarded Recursion Procedure
hints.text: Track open count and close count. If open < n, append '(' and recurse with open + 1. If close < open, append ')' and recurse with close + 1. When path reaches length 2n, save the string.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

variables: N: number of pairs of parentheses (1 <= N <= 8)
complexity.notes: Bounded by the N-th Catalan number C_n = (1 / (n + 1)) * (2n choose n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all 2^(2n) sequences takes exponential time checking invalid candidates.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Call recursion stack is depth 2n using linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Enforcing valid prefix invariant and connecting solution to Catalan numbers.
